Product & Service Notification





 
 We are notifying all customers regarding critical, mandatory updates to Salesforce certificates. To protect your organization from immediate security vulnerabilities and prevent severe service disruptions, you must review and act upon the three essential requirements detailed below:
 
 


 
 1. Urgent Requirement: Dual-Use Certificate Deprecation
 
 


 
 To prevent critical integration failures and complete service outages stemming from the impending industry-wide ban on dual-use certificates, immediate and decisive action is required. Technical teams must immediately migrate to separate client certificates and strictly verify mTLS compliance to safeguard operational continuity and enterprise data. Maintaining full security compliance is an absolute imperative that must take precedence over all other scheduling considerations.
 

WARNING: Regardless of recent timeline adjustments announced by Chrome, immediate implementation is vital to avert severe security non-compliance risks. You must immediately review 
http://click.mail.salesforce.com/?qs=ABp7ImQiOjUwNDQsInQiOjExMzQyLCJzIjo4fQAIAAAAAAAMvT2qMX6CrQ5tZRoK14X5VxW1kac30MHLMJVCq5kBw_ipaYlmg_FY8aNdUjTV03XECMicnNS7vZekZGdoKvnNKY_lrZTvRg 
this article  detailing Salesforce-supported CAs and execute your mitigation strategy without delay.
 


 
 2. Strategic Alignment: Mandatory Reduction of Certificate Lifespans
 
 


 
 In response to rapidly escalating cyber threats and evolving industry security mandates, Salesforce is enforcing a dramatic reduction in TLS server certificate lifespans, dropping from 200 days to just 47 days by March 2029. To prevent sudden operational downtime and maintain basic platform integrity, organizations must immediately establish rigorous, automated processes for accelerated certificate renewals and rotations.
 
 


 
 3. Managing Root Certificates and Trust Stores
